data.name: Atiq
data.gender_notes: Atiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is ancient, old, and possesses wisdom and knowledge. The name Atiq carries the meaning “Ancient, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Atiq usually hope their child will grow to embody ancient, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a person who is deeply connected to the ancient wisdom and knowledge of the universe.
data.etymology: Atiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ancient, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atiq total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عتيق
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عتق يدل على الحرية والتحرر
in_arabic.long_meaning: العتيق هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي تم إطلاق سراحه من العبودية أو الأسر، و هو مشتق من كلمة عتق التي تأتي من الجذر العربي ع-ت-ق والذي يحمل معاني الحرية والتحرر. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن تحرير العبيد. يعتبر اسم عتيق من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية و يرمز إلى قيمة الحرية و الكرامة الإنسانية.

in_urdu.name: عتیق
in_urdu.meaning: آزادی یافتہ، وہ شخص جو غلامی سے آزاد ہو گیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عتیق ایک مشہور مذکر نام ہے جس کی اصل العربية ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو غلامی یا قید سے آزاد ہو چکا ہے۔ یہ نام عتق سے ماخوذ ہے، جو العربية کی ایک جڑ ہے جس کے معنی ہیں آزاد کرنا یا چھڑانا۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، یہ نام آزادی اور خود مختاری کی علامت ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان، یہ نام عتیق کے تاریخی اور ثقافتی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अतीक
in_hindi.meaning: आज़ाद किया हुआ, गुलामी से मुक्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: अतीक एक प्रसिद्ध पुरुष नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है गुलामी या बंधन से मुक्त व्यक्ति। यह नाम عتق (अतिक) से लिया गया है, जो العربية की एक मूल ध्वनि है जिसका अर्थ है मुक्त करना या छुड़ाना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अतीक की ऐतिहासिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्ता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: عتیق
in_pashto.meaning: آزاد شوی، له غلامۍ څخه ازاد
in_pashto.long_meaning: عتیق د یو مشهور مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي اصلي څخه دي. دا نوم د هغه چا معنی دی چی له غلامۍ څخه آزاد شوی دی. دا د عتق څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چی د عربي يو ريښی دی چی د آزادۍ معنی ورکوي. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د عتیق تاريخي او کلتوري اهميت څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Atiq
in_english.meaning: liberated, freed from slavery or bondage
in_english.long_meaning: Atiq is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'liberated' or 'freed'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'a-t-q', which conveys the sense of freedom and release. This name appears in the context of freeing slaves in the Quran. Atiq holds significant cultural and spiritual importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing human dignity and the value of freedom. Across Muslim cultures, the name Atiq is associated with positive personality traits such as independence and self-determination.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Atiq" holds a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is admired for being a name of great antiquity, reminding us of the depth of history and lineage that connects us to our ancestors. It is often given to a child as a name that carries the weight of wisdom and experience, instilling a strong sense of legacy and heritage. In various Muslim societies, elders and scholars are sometimes referred to with this name as a mark of respect for their age and knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Atiq" signifies a connection to the timeless wisdom and guidance of Allah. It is believed that the ancient knowledge and understanding of the Divine revealed through the Quran and Hadith are embodied in those considered to be "Atiq" - those who possess profound knowledge, wisdom, and faith. The name is seen as a reminder to strive for learning and spiritual growth throughout one's life, staying humble and open to wisdom from both the past and the present.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Ancient, Wise" symbolizes A person who is ancient, old, and possesses wisdom and knowledge.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Atiq serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of ancient, wise.

historical_references.reference: Atiq ibn Abi Al-As is mentioned in Ibn Hisham's Sirah Rasul Allah (Life of the Prophet) as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad.
